summary: Implemented vaultwares-agentciation as the workspace source of truth for reusable agent infrastructure. Restructured docs into docs/ with root pointer stubs and added CONTEXT.md. Added tooling: audit_agent_surfaces.py (workspace scan), migrate_agent_assets.py (cautious importer), sync_agentciation_rules.py (managed-block sync + optional .github/agents snapshot sync). Ran audit across local repos and imported the vaultwares-pipelines .github/agents SKILL.md snapshot into vaultwares-agentciation under skills/mirrors/. Added vaultwares-agentciation as a git submodule to repos that had agent instruction surfaces but lacked it, and synced managed blocks into existing CLAUDE.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md across consumer repos.
